primitives.name: Player Tracking Kernel
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'x(t)': 'position vector in meters', 'v(t)': 'velocity vector in m/s', 'a(t)': 'acceleration vector in m/s²'}
primitives.assumptions: Players' trajectories are continuous differentiable functions of time; sensor noise is additive Gaussian white noise.
primitives.breakdown_regime: At sub-millisecond resolution or when tracking fails due to occlusion.

layer2.mapping: Maps discrete spatiotemporal coordinates into a continuous phase space for differential analysis.
layer2.telemetry: Euclidean distance between tracked points and predicted trajectory.

primitives.name: Kinematic Entropy
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'p_i': 'probability of observing player i at position x_i', 'N': 'total number of players'}
primitives.assumptions: Entropy quantifies uncertainty in player distribution; assumes uniform prior over spatial bins.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When player clustering exceeds threshold for information loss.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to Shannon entropy applied to positional probability density derived from tracking data.
layer2.telemetry: Spatial variance of player positions normalized by total field area.

primitives.name: Temporal Coherence Field
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {"v(t')": "velocity vector at time t'", 't_0': 'initial time', 't': 'current time'}
primitives.assumptions: Velocity integral yields displacement field; assumes constant sampling rate.
primitives.breakdown_regime: During sudden deceleration or abrupt directional change.

layer2.mapping: Derives coherent motion paths from instantaneous velocity vectors over time intervals.
layer2.telemetry: Mean squared error between actual and predicted path segments.
